page0.text: I haven't thanked Sakura for cooking dinner yet, so I should talk to Sakura.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page0:1

page1.text: "It's getting late, so I should walk her home."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page1:1

page2.text:
Sakura just finished cleaning up, and she's in the living room getting ready to go home.
"Oh, Senpai. I thought you were taking your bath."
"I'll take my bath later, after I walk you home."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page2:1

page3.text:
"Eh? You're going to walk...me home?"
"Yeah. It's been dangerous at night lately so I'll walk you home. Your house is a pretty long walk, so let me at least do this, since you go out of your way to come here."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page3:1

page4.text:
"..."
Sakura purses her lips awkwardly.
...Did I say something wrong?
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page4:1

page5.text:
"I'm sorry. I appreciate your concern, but you should rest. I know my way home from here, and I should be fine alone."
"Maybe so, but it really hasn't been safe recently. I'll walk you home at night for a while."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page5:1

page6.text:
"...But, well...it will cause trouble for you if my brother sees you."
"Ah..."
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page6:1

page7.text:
I forgot.
Sakura's older brother Shinji doesn't really like Sakura coming over to my place.
He can't say much because Sakura says she goes to Fuji-nee's house, but me taking her home might cause problems.
I don't care if Shinji accuses me of something I didn't actually do, but I don't want him taking it out on Sakura.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page7:1

page8.text:
"But it wouldn't be a problem if I only walked you halfway, right? There's no way we'll see Shinji at the intersection."
"..."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page8:1

page9.text:
Sakura is uncomfortably silent.
Knowing Sakura, she probably couldn't even lie about the fact that I walked her home.
"Hey, then how about—"
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page9:1

page10.text:
"Want me to walk her home?"
An English teacher wearing tiger stripes suddenly pokes her head through the door.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page10:1

page11.text:
"That really doesn't fix anything. My concern is that a girl's walking alone at night, so adding another girl would be—"
...Wait a minute.
Calling Fuji-nee a girl may be a bit of a misnomer.
There is a reason Fuji-nee is the teacher in charge of the kyudou club.
She was trained by Old Man Fujimura in kendo, and her fifth rank designation makes her deadly, literally and figuratively.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page11:1

page12.text:
"I guess it wouldn't be a problem if you went, Fuji-nee. I bet you could beat the crap out of any perverts who might try to strike."
"Of course I can. And that's why walking Sakura home is not a problem. Are you good with it, Sakura?"
Yes. As long as it's okay with you.
"That settles it. Let's get going. I was just thinking I should go home, too."
Fuji-nee takes Sakura's hand and starts to leave.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page12:1

page13.text:
"Oh, hold on a minute, Sakura."
"What is it, Senpai?"
"Dinner was good. Thank you."
...
"Of course. As long as you don't mind, I will keep working on my cooking, Senpai."
Sakura beams and leaves the living room.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page13:1

page14.text:
...
I can tell my cheeks are burning red.
Honestly, Sakura takes me by surprise a lot lately. It's...perplexing.
Time sure flies. Not so long ago, she was just my friend's little sister. Now, I find sometimes I can't quite look away from her.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート一日目-13:page14:1
